summary: More community.postgresql deprecations: rename_to in postgresql_sequence and postgresql_tablespace and rename in postgresql_table (use postgresql_query), plus db/database aliases in set, slot, subscription, table, tablespace and user_obj_stat_info (use login_db).
questions: How do I rename a PostgreSQL table with Ansible going forward?

answer_card.title: PostgreSQL rename options deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
- `postgresql_table` `rename`, and `postgresql_sequence` / `postgresql_tablespace` `rename_to`, are deprecated (removed in 5.0.0). Use `postgresql_query` with the matching `ALTER ... RENAME` SQL.
- The `db`/`database` aliases in `postgresql_set`, `_slot`, `_subscription`, `_table`, `_tablespace` and `_user_obj_stat_info` are deprecated. Use `login_db`.
